A fixture seed for the unit tests: the shape of a fresh archive, with no rows.

The real archive lives at `docs/gymnasium/` and grows every week, so the tests
that exercise the MECHANISM seed from here instead — a suite that broke because
the company filed another proposal would be testing the wrong thing. One test
seeds from the real archive on purpose, to assert FR-12.6's continuity.
